description: Test suite for board-related functionalities in the focalboard server, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, duplication, membership management, and template handling, specifically within integration tests.

methods.name: TestGetBoards
methods.description: Tests retrieval of boards, including access control and filtering by user membership.

methods.name: TestCreateBoard
methods.description: Tests creation of public and private boards, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: TestCreateBoardTemplate
methods.description: Tests creation of board templates (public and private) and access to their blocks.

methods.name: TestGetAllBlocksForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all blocks within a board, including hierarchical structure.

methods.name: TestSearchBoards
methods.description: Tests searching for boards with various search terms and access restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific board with different permission scenarios and read tokens.

methods.name: TestGetBoardMetadata
methods.description: Tests fetching metadata for a board, including updates after block modifications and deletion.

methods.name: TestPatchBoard
methods.description: Tests updating board properties with permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests deleting a board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestUndeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests restoring a deleted board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetMembersForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving members of a board, including permission checks.

methods.name: TestAddMember
methods.description: Tests adding members to a board, role assignment, and permission validation.

methods.name: TestUpdateMember
methods.description: Tests updating board member roles, ensuring at least one admin remains, and permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteMember
methods.description: Tests removing members from a board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetTemplates
methods.description: Tests retrieval of built-in templates and their duplication.

methods.name: TestDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests duplicating boards, including from categories, and verifying member roles and categories.

methods.name: TestJoinBoard
methods.description: Tests joining public boards with different roles and permission scenarios.
